SELECT id,name,code,disabled FROM ( SELECT vw.id,vw.name,vw.code,vw.disabled from virtual_warehouse vw where vw.is_deleted = FALSE
and ((vw.code ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%') or vw.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
order by
case when vw.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when vw.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when vw.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , vw.name,
vw.disabled ) warehouse

SELECT vw.id,vw.name,vw.code,vw.disabled from virtual_warehouse vw where vw.is_deleted = FALSE
and ((vw.code ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%') or vw.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
order by
case when vw.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when vw.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when vw.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , vw.name,
vw.disabled

SELECT DISTINCT vw.id,vw.name,vw.code ,vw.disabled from virtual_warehouse vw left join virtual_warehouse_relation vwr on vw.id = vwr.virtual_warehouse_id and vwr.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse_channel vwc on vwc.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vwc.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse_channel_partition_ref vwcpr on vwcpr.main_id = vwc.id and vwcpr.is_deleted = false where vw.is_deleted = false
and (vwc.relation_id = #{params.relationId} or vwc.relation_id is null or vwc.relation_id = '')
and (vwc.relation_id is null or vwc.relation_id = '')
and vwc.dict_platform = #{params.dictPlatform}
and (vwcpr.partition_id = #{params.partitionId} or vwcpr.partition_id is null or vwcpr.partition_id = '')
and (vwcpr.partition_id is null or vwcpr.partition_id = '')
and vwr.warehouse_id = #{params.warehouseId}
select id from virtual_warehouse WHERE is_deleted=false and code ${compareCodeSplicingValueSql}
